saved mask (C44) comes from mask.npy (C34). That mask runs the per-cell run/merge logic over hot = V_tgt >= thr_sm[doys-1] (C33) for sea cells defined by finiteness of V_tgt on all 92 target days. thr_sm is a cumsum-based wrap-around smoothing (C30) of hazen 90th-percentile pools built from V_base, which spans 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 over the correct 60x60 region (C29). Because the cumsum feeds every threshold day into each smoothed value, all baseline days (including the 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 extensions) reach the mask, along with all target days 2009-06-01..2009-08-31."}
